connect.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect {{label}}? Posts already published will stay live on {{network}}.

meta.title: Facebook & Instagram
meta.body: Connect a Facebook Page. If it's linked to an Instagram Business account, that's connected automatically — one grant covers both.
meta.select_intro: Facebook sent every Page you've ever given CloseBoss access to — not just the one you ticked just now. Pick the ones you actually want to publish from. Anything you leave unticked is discarded along with its access token.
meta.select_revoke_note: Declining here removes the Page from CloseBoss, but Facebook still remembers the grant, so it will reappear next time you connect. To stop that for good, remove CloseBoss under Facebook → Settings → Apps and Websites.
meta.empty: No Pages connected yet. Connect one to start publishing.
meta.revoke_hint_prefix: Granted scopes are stored encrypted; disconnect any time. To fully revoke the OAuth grant from Facebook's side too, visit your Facebook account's

linkedin.title: LinkedIn
linkedin.body: Post to your personal LinkedIn feed. Real-estate professionals see strong engagement here — listings, market updates, and client wins all do well.
linkedin.empty: Not connected. Sign in with LinkedIn to enable posting.
linkedin.revoke_hint_prefix: Posts go to your personal LinkedIn feed. Company Page posting needs LinkedIn's Marketing API (partner-program-gated) and isn't in scope yet. To revoke from LinkedIn's side, go to your LinkedIn Settings → Data privacy →

threads.title: Threads
threads.body: Auto-post your marketing to Threads. Casual, conversational posts perform best here — quick takes, market observations, and behind-the-scenes wins.
threads.empty: Not connected. Sign in with Threads to enable posting.
threads.revoke_hint: Posts publish to the connected Threads account. To revoke from Threads' side, open Threads → Settings → Account → Website permissions and remove CloseBoss.

google_ads.title: Google Ads
google_ads.body: Search + Performance Max campaigns from inside Generate Leads.

pinterest.body: Auto-publish Pins — listing photos, neighborhood guides, branded cards — to a board on your Pinterest business account.
pinterest.empty: Connect a Pinterest business account to schedule Pins. New Pins post to your first board.
pinterest.revoke_hint: Disconnecting removes the token stored here. To fully revoke, remove the app in your Pinterest account settings.

tiktok.body: Post your videos — listing tours, avatar clips — straight to TikTok. New videos start private until your TikTok app passes the Content Posting audit.
tiktok.empty: Connect a TikTok account to post videos. Until your app is audited, posts are private (only you see them).
tiktok.revoke_hint: Disconnecting removes the token stored here. To fully revoke, remove the app in your TikTok account settings.

youtube.body: Upload your videos — listing tours, avatar clips — to your YouTube channel. Vertical clips land as Shorts.
youtube.empty: Connect a YouTube channel to upload videos. Vertical videos post as Shorts.
youtube.revoke_hint: Disconnecting removes the token stored here. To fully revoke, remove access in your Google account settings.
